attchmntText: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ecos India Mobility and Hospitality Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026, accompanied by a Limited Review Report. Additionally, the Board approved the constitution of the Strategy and Performance Review Committee along with its terms of reference. The meeting commenced at 12:15 PM and concluded at 16:30 PM IST. The financial results are attached to the original filing.

attchmntText: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Ecos India Mobility and Hospitality Limited has announced an earnings conference call for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST. The discussion will cover operational and financial performance. Participants include Chairman and Managing Director Rajesh Loomba, Joint Managing Director Adity Loomba, Chief Operating Officer Deepali Dev, and Chief Financial Officer Hem Kumar Upadhyay. Access numbers and a registration link are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Ecos (India) Mobility & Hospitality Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation of Board Meeting' for Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026
